purpose: Render original character designs through the verified Krea2 workflow without redesigning their identity.

sourceRoles.characterReference: identity, face, age presentation, anatomy, body proportion, pose, silhouette, hair or prosthetic structure, clothing construction, weapons, props, color blocking and all character-specific design facts
sourceRoles.styleReference: line density, flat-color transitions, restrained shading, material edges, palette treatment, industrial lighting and composition grammar only

hardRejectVisuals: natural hair replacing canonical hair or cable structure
altered garment silhouette or invented costume details
changed eye color or eye-side assignment
changed body ratio, limb count, hand count or finger anatomy
missing or redesigned signature weapon or prop
third-party character traits mixed into the subject
glossy 3D, doll-like or photoreal treatment when the canonical reference is flat 2D design-sheet art
cropped feet, hidden hands, text, logos, watermarks or UI
